title: Adjustment Credit Validity and Use by Line — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
A treadwear adjustment credit issued on a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set is usable toward replacement tires for a fixed number of calendar days counted from the adjustment date. The lines differ in how long the credit lasts, which tires it may buy and whether the replacement tire's mounting and balancing is charged.

| Line | Credit usable for | Replacement must be the same line | Mounting and balancing of the replacement included |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 30 days | Yes | No |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 30 days | Yes | No |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 60 days | No | No |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 60 days | No | No |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 90 days | No | Yes |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 90 days | No | Yes |

- "Same line: Yes" means the credit buys only a tire of the same line as the adjusted set; "No" means any Crestline tire line may be bought with it.
- "Mounting included: Yes" means the replacement tire's mounting and balancing is not charged on the replacement ticket.

**Validity, both sides (hypothetical dates):** a 30-day credit issued on the 1st of a 31-day month is usable through the 31st and lapses on the 1st of the next month; a 90-day credit is usable through the 90th day after the adjustment date and lapses the day after.
